game.name: battlecode-2025
game.description: MIT Battlecode 2025 with the original Java 21 engine, maps, rules, and per-robot bytecode budgets.

player.value: Upload the unchanged Java scaffold zipForSubmit submission.zip (packages at ZIP root, or src/<package>/RobotPlayer.java). Select the case-sensitive entrypoint with league preference package=<package>. The original RobotController/Clock API executes inside the JVM with upstream instrumentation.

global.value: GET /client/global shows episode status and links to the original Battlecode replay viewer after completion. /global is a WebSocket sending JSON phase/result snapshots and answering Ping frames. This initial port does not stream live board frames. Replays are original gzip-compressed FlatBuffers .bc25 files.

readme.value: Battlecode 2025: original Java 21 JVM engine, bytecode limits and maps. Upload an unchanged Java scaffold submission.zip; choose the package through the league submission preference. Slots 0/1 are A/B; winner scores 1, loser 0. See https://github.com/Metta-AI/coworld-battlecode-2025 for instructions.
